text: SELECT assays.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, activities.standard_type, activities.pchembl_value FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assays ON assays.tid = td.tid JOIN activities ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON activities.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293237' AND activities.standard_type = 'IC50' AND activities.standard_relation = '=' AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, assays.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
